calculation.expression: (close[t-1] / close[t-1-20] - 1) * (0.5 + 0.5 * mean(sign(pct_change(close,1)) > 0 over sessions t-20 through t-1))
calculation.description: Twenty-session price momentum multiplied by a persistence score, rewarding assets whose recent directional movement contains more positive daily returns.
calculation.signal_artifact: For each completed decision date t, calculate from closes through t-1 only and rank cross-sectionally across the 15 tradable instruments. Forward return is close[t+10]/close[t]-1 for validation; no future observations enter the signal.

validation.regime_notes: Revalidation through 2028-04-19 used 1,829 dates and all 15 tradable instruments (minimum 8; average 15). Full-period IC remained above threshold, but daily ICIR 0.04650 fell below 0.0840; recent 250-date IC was -0.03084 and ICIR -0.10807, indicating material performance drift. Deprecated pending future recovery.
